_comment: Minimal working asset kit. Copy this folder into your own profile and restyle it. Screen ids match element ids in stage.html; scene names match window.SCENES in motion.html. Render with: python3 tools/render-assets.py --profile <name>

intro._audio_comment: Optional. 'path' is relative to this kit; licensed music is normally kept OUTSIDE the repo, so a missing file renders the scene silent. Override per run with --audio PATH.

text._comment: Defaults for every round; event.json overrides them, --set overrides both.
